description: This source file defines the LoanBusinessEvent class, which extends BusinessEvent and encapsulates external event data related to loan business events, including verification logic comparing external event payloads with internal object properties.

classes.name: LoanBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a loan-related external business event, with properties for status, principal amounts, and loan term variations, along with verification logic for external payloads.

methods.name: LoanBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with type, date, status, principal amounts, and optional loan term variations.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that the external event payload matches the internal properties, including status, principal disbursed, outstanding, and loan term variations.

methods.name: loanTermVariationsMatch
